Figure 8:Evolution of the ontology for a card-legality task.
The Initial state contains general Card and Legality semantics but
no explicit interpretation of legality status. The accepted patch
adds a Legality Status Code Term, its Mapping and Evidence, and a
Constraint that relates the status value to the requested format.
Red dashed boxes mark the added or refined objects.
